title: All-hands Q2 announce draft
content:
Purpose: quick draft of the Q2 all-hands announcement + talking points. Rough notes, not final.

High level messaging (short blurb for Slack/email):
- Save the date: Company All-Hands — Tue Apr 7, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (60 min).
- Focus: Q1 highlights, product roadmap updates (Dedicated + Private rollouts), performance & reliability metrics, headcount and org changes, Q&A.
- Location: Zoom link (calendar invite). Recording will be shared.

Draft announcement copy (for 1st internal blast):
Hey team —

Mark your calendars for our Q2 All-Hands on Tue Apr 7 at 10:00 PT. We’ll share a short Q1 recap, roadmap milestones for the next quarter, and a product demo of the new Dedicated autoscaling UI. There will be time for live Q&A at the end.

Agenda (60m):
- 00:00–00:05 — Welcome + logistics (CEO)
- 00:05–00:20 — Q1 highlights: usage, revenue, notable customers (GTM leader)
- 00:20–00:35 — Product & roadmap: Hosted API improvements, Dedicated autoscale, Private deployment launch plan (Product + Eng leads)
- 00:35–00:45 — Serving runtime & reliability: latency improvements and incident recap (Eng/DevRel)
- 00:45–00:55 — People & org updates (People Ops / Hiring)
- 00:55–01:00 — Live Q&A (moderated)

Key talking points / prompts for speakers:
- CEO (00:00–00:05): thanks, quick framing: mission reminder (serve inference reliably + economically), high-level momentum (usage growth, bridges to enterprise). Keep it optimistic and concise.
- GTM (00:05–00:20): concrete metrics: MAU or API calls growth (X% vs Q4), top 5 customers onboarded, notable case study highlight (redacted for privacy). Mention ARR signals if OK with finance.
- Product (00:20–00:35): demo notes for Dedicated autoscaling UI — show flow: reserve pool -> configure autoscale policy -> real-time metric trace. Call out rollout timeline for Dedicated customers and beta for private deployments.
- Eng / Runtime (00:35–00:45): ownership: summarize latency P50/P95 improvements, top optimizations (kernel selection + KV cache), brief incident retrospective (what happened, corrective steps, how customers were protected).
- People Ops (00:45–00:55): hiring velocity, open roles, remote/hybrid policy update (if any), upcoming team socials.

Q&A prep / likely questions (prep answers in bullet form):
- "What happened during the Feb incident?" -> short timeline + automation we added + customer impact (none for X customers) + follow up artifacts (postmortem link).
- "Any pricing changes?" -> No planned changes this quarter; reiterate current pricing model and cost tools (Redwood Optimize).
- "When will Private GA?" -> tentative dates: beta in mid-May, GA in July (subject to security sign-offs). Mention pilot customers.
- "Dedicated capacity cost & commit terms?" -> high-level: monthly/annual commits; Sales will follow up for specifics.

Logistics & to-dos (who owns):
- Finalize attendee list + calendar invite (Maya) — due 2026-03-09
- Draft email / Slack announcement copy (Maya + Jordan) — due 2026-03-12
- Slides: CEO (opening), GTM (metrics + customer slide), Product demo deck (Evan), Eng incident recap slide (Lina), People Ops slide (Maya) — slide drafts due 2026-03-20
- Rehearsal: run-through with speakers 48 hours prior (schedule after slides done)
- Confluence post: create post-meeting summary template (must include links to recording, slides, follow-up actions) (Jordan)

Unresolved / discussion items (notes to self):
- Do we want a short live demo vs pre-recorded for the Dedicated autoscale UI? Pre-recorded reduces risk but less interactive. Check infra readiness. (ask Product + Infra)
- Should we include a slide with unit economics improvements (cost/token saved)? Finance might need to approve. (ask Evan)
- Tone: keep product messaging concrete, avoid promising dates for private GA.

Notes / scratchpad bits (for internal use):
- Quick shoutouts section? maybe 1–2 team highlights only, keep to time.
- Consider an inline poll (Slack) post-all-hands to collect feedback and questions not answered.
- Moderation plan: collect live Qs in Zoom + prioritize top 5. Moderator: Jordan.

Version history / meta:
- v0.1 (2026-02-18) initial topic + agenda
- v0.2 (2026-02-25) added speaker owners and draft FAQ
- v0.3 (2026-03-02) tightened agenda & added to-dos

References / links to prep materials:
- Confluence: INTERNAL-ALLHANDS-Q2 (skeleton slides, metrics)
- Jira: COMM-42 (announcement copy + assets)
- Slack: #all-hands-thread-2026-q2 for coordination

Questions for collaborators:
- Jordan: can you confirm the product demo availability window and whether infra prefers pre-record?
- Evan: quick approval on whether to include revenue numbers (high level) in GTM slide?
- Lina: can you prepare a 3-slide incident recap that fits 8–10 minutes?

-- end draft --

(Keep this doc in users area. Will move to shared_drives/company/comm once final.)
